newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha quiet, tone easier in line with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha quiet, tone easier in line with crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha lost ground on Friday reflecting easier crude and muted end-user demand.
Swaps were 50 cents to $1 easier and physical about $1 a tonne weaker around $221 cif NWE.
Dealers said end-user petchem demand remained muted and was not expected to show a substantial increase before the middle of February.
Interest from U.S buyers also waned in line with very high freight rates and those cargoes hoping to make a trans-atlantic trip will probably have to find a home in Europe, said traders.
